Game: Overtake
Genre: Racing
About: A fast pseudo-3D arcade racer with unlockable routes, garage progression, and nitro boosts.
How to play: Pick a route, choose a car, then race through pseudo-3D traffic. Finish well to earn coins, unlock faster cars, and open later routes. Use nitro when the bar has charge, collect nitro refills on the road, and avoid losing speed in collisions.
Controls: Arrow Keys / WASD: Steer, accelerate, and brake; Space / Shift / N: Use nitro; P / Esc: Pause; R: Restart current route; touch; mouse
How to play (on-page): Pick a route, choose a car, then race through pseudo-3D traffic. Finish well to earn coins, unlock faster cars, and open later routes. Use nitro when the bar has charge, collect nitro refills on the road, and avoid losing speed in collisions.
Arrow Keys / WASD - Drive Space / Shift / N - Nitro P / Esc - Pause R - Restart route
